About Me

01

I'm Eunice Tinega — a hardworking, creative, and determined learner turning curiosity into skill, one project at a time.

Technology excites me. From computers and artificial intelligence to graphic design, digital productivity, and website development, I'm drawn to tools and ideas that help people create, communicate, and solve real problems. I believe continuous learning and creativity open doors that talent alone can't.

I'm currently building these skills at Beacon Technical Training Institute, where hands-on training in computer packages, design, and digital tools is shaping how I think and create.

My goal is simple: keep growing my digital and professional skills, and use them to build solutions that matter — and a career I'm proud of.
